page.title: Verification
page.intro: Verification tells colleagues that you are a physician licensed in Israel, or a medical student in Israel. It does not say anything else about you, and it is not a recommendation.

statuses.WAITING: Your request is waiting for a reviewer.
statuses.REFUSED: Your last request was not approved.

page.byOrganisation: An organisation you belong to vouches for you. There is nothing for you to send.
page.renewNow: Your verification ends soon. You can ask to renew it now.
page.whatOpens: Until you are verified you can read what is open to everyone and fill in your profile. The directory, chat, rooms and what is for verified physicians open once you are verified.
page.documentHeld: Your school’s confirmation is held until the request is decided, then deleted.
page.profileFirst: Please fill in your first and last name in your profile first. The reviewer looks you up by name.

form.title: Ask to be verified
form.answerHint: Say what changed, or what the reviewer should know.
form.licenceHint: As on your licence from the Ministry of Health. It is kept encrypted and never shown to anyone, the reviewer included.
form.graduationHint: Your verification lasts until this date, and can be renewed.
form.documentHint: A current letter or certificate saying that you study there: a PDF or a picture, up to 10 MB. Only the reviewer sees it, and it is deleted once your request is decided.
form.submitted: Thank you. Your request was sent; we will write to you with the answer.

review.title: Verifying physicians
review.intro: Check each physician in the Ministry of Health’s public register, and each student’s confirmation from their school. Search the register by name, then type the number the register shows: it is compared with the one the person gave, which you never see.
review.registerLink: Open the Ministry of Health’s register
review.notAllowed: Verifying physicians is for the platform’s reviewers.
review.waiting: {days, plural, =0 {Waiting since today} one {Waiting for # day} other {Waiting for # days}}
review.certificateGiven: A specialist certificate number was given.
review.documentGone: The confirmation is no longer held.
review.registerLicence: Licence number, as the register shows it
review.registerCertificate: Specialist certificate number, as the register shows it
review.studentCheck: Read the confirmation: the school, the student’s name, and that it is current.

start.ask: The directory, chat, rooms and what is for verified physicians open once you are verified. It takes a few minutes to ask.
start.waiting: Your request to be verified is waiting for a reviewer. We will write to you with the answer.

steps.profile: Complete your profile: your title and a photo
steps.directory: Choose whether colleagues find you in the directory

start.inviteIntro: We send them an email on how to join. It doesn’t verify them; they ask like everyone else.
start.inviteSent: Thank you. If the address can receive an invitation, it is on its way.
